title: A Second Life
description: Photographer Irina Rozovsky took this photo in the summer of 2016 on the shore of Lake Ohrid in Macedonia. "While driving around photographing, I was moved by the plethora of wild flowers growing in every direction the eye could see, especially red poppies," she told National Geographic. Rozovsky began picking up bottles that litter the streets in the absence of trash cans, then decided to turn them into vases. "I just loved the fresh hopefulness." The image is featured in Rozovsky's new book, Mountain Black Heart, published by MACK.
translated_description: 摄影师伊琳娜·罗佐夫斯基于2016年夏天在马其顿奥赫里德湖畔拍下了这张照片。“开车四处拍摄时，目之所及，遍地野花，尤其是红罂粟，令我深受感动，”她告诉《国家地理》。由于没有垃圾桶，罗佐夫斯基开始捡起散落街头的瓶子，并决定将它们改造成花瓶。“我就是喜欢这种清新的希望感。”这张照片收录在罗佐夫斯基由MACK出版的新书《黑色山心》中。
